subject: Request: apportionment of Q2 charges + VAT proof for refund
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena@nebulacorp.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>
Cc: accounts-payable@nebulacorp.com
Date: Wed, 29 Jul 2026 08:12:00 +0000
Subject: Unexpected Q2 charge — request for split and VAT docs

Hi Evelyn,

We reviewed our June invoice (attached: NEB-INV-202606.pdf) and see a charge for Dedicated (reserved) capacity that overlaps with hosted billing during our migration window (Jun 10–Jun 17). This looks like a double-bill for the same traffic. Total disputed amount on invoice: EUR 12,480 (VAT inclusive).

To process a reclaim with our tax team we need: 1) a credit or split that isolates the duplicate portion, and 2) an official VAT statement so we can reclaim the VAT on our end. Can you confirm your recommended path (credit memo vs reissued invoices) and the documents you can provide?

We'd like to get this sorted before our month-end close (Aug 2). I can provide our VAT certificate on request.

Thanks,
Elena Ruiz
Finance Manager — Nebula Analytics
accounts-payable@nebulacorp.com

Attachments: NEB-INV-202606.pdf (invoice PDF, 1 page)

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@nebulacorp.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 29 Jul 2026 10:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Unexpected Q2 charge — request for split and VAT docs

Hi Elena — thanks for flagging this and for the invoice. I'm looping in Ben (billing ops) and Laura (accounting) to confirm whether we double-billed during the migration window. We'll aim to: 1) apportion the overlapping usage, 2) issue either a credit memo or a corrected invoice (whichever is simplest for VAT reclaims), and 3) provide formal VAT evidence.

Ben/Laura — can you take a look at NEB-INV-202606 and propose the fastest path for Nebula? Customer asked for completion by Aug 2.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Senior Account Executive — Redwood Inference
(evelyn@redwood.com)

---
Forwarded attachment: NEB-INV-202606.pdf

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 29 Jul 2026 11:43:00 +0000
Subject: RE: Unexpected Q2 charge — request for split and VAT docs (internal analysis)

Evy/Laura — I pulled the usage logs and billing ledger for account NB-2026-045. Summary:
- Period: 2026-06-01 to 2026-06-30
- Overlap window reported: 2026-06-10 03:00 UTC to 2026-06-17 22:00 UTC
- Overbilled tokens (approx): 4.2M tokens attributed to hosted route while dedicated capacity was still active.
- Gross disputed amount on invoice: EUR 10,500 (net) + EUR 1,980 VAT = EUR 12,480 (matches customer).

Recommendation (fastest path for EU VAT reclaim):
1) Issue a credit memo (negative invoice) that references NEB-INV-202606 and clearly states taxable base and VAT amount reversed. This allows Nebula to process a local reclaim.
2) Attach our VAT registration evidence and a brief explanatory note.
3) If customer prefers, we can alternatively reissue the invoice with apportionment lines (longer accounting process).

Operational notes: credit memo will be created with credit memo id RI-CM-NB-0729 and will include a VAT reversal line using the same VAT rate. Accounting will have to post the negative VAT in the month of issuance.

ETA: I can have a draft credit memo ready by EOD Thu (2026-07-30) if Laura signs off.

Ben
Billing Operations — Redwood Inference

(Internal attachment: usage-extract-NB-202606.csv — token counts & route breakdown)

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@nebulacorp.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Jul 2026 09:21:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Unexpected Q2 charge — request for split and VAT docs

Hi Elena — quick update: Ben confirmed this looks like an overlap and recommends a credit memo (fastest for your VAT reclaim).

Proposed next steps:
- We will issue a credit memo (RI-CM-NB-0729) that matches the disputed net and VAT lines.
- Please send your VAT certificate (company registration & VAT number) so we can include it in the customer file and on the credit memo PDF.
- Confirm whether you prefer the credit to be applied as an immediate account credit or as a refund to the original payment method.

If it's helpful I can also share a draft credit memo before issuance.

Thanks — aiming to close this by Aug 2 as requested.

Best regards,
Evelyn
Senior Account Executive — Redwood Inference

Attachment: proposed-credit-memo-draft.pdf (stub, will be finalised once VAT cert received)

From: Elena Ruiz <elena@nebulacorp.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>
Cc: accounts-payable@nebulacorp.com
Date: Thu, 30 Jul 2026 13:08:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Unexpected Q2 charge — request for split and VAT docs

Hi Evelyn — thanks for the quick turnaround. Attached is our VAT certificate as requested (VAT-CERT-Nebula.pdf).

We'd prefer the credit applied as a refund to the original payment method if possible (the amount was paid via bank transfer). If refund isn't feasible before their month-end close, an account credit will be fine as long as we get the official credit memo and VAT breakdown to support our reclaim.

I'll also add our PO ref: PO-NB-7782 for your records.

Thanks,
Elena

Attachments: VAT-CERT-Nebula.pdf (company VAT certificate)

From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@nebulacorp.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 31 Jul 2026 15:40:00 +0000
Subject: RE: Unexpected Q2 charge — request for split and VAT docs

Hi Elena — thanks for the VAT cert and PO ref. We've issued the credit memo and updated invoice:

- Credit memo: RI-CM-NB-0729 (amount: EUR 10,500 net, EUR 1,980 VAT) — attached as RI-credit-memo-NB-20260729.pdf
- Updated invoice (apportioned): RI-updated-invoice-NB-202607.pdf (attached)
- Refund preference: we can process a bank refund; please reply with the original payment reference or confirm you'd like the amount as an account credit.

Accounting notes: the credit reverses the VAT for June; we'll post the negative VAT in July (credit note date 2026-07-31). If Nebula needs a stamped fiscal note or any additional supporting files for local authorities let us know and we can add them.

Closing action for Nebula: confirm refund vs account credit and provide payment reference if you want a bank refund.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Senior Manager, Customer Accounting — Redwood Inference

Attachments: RI-credit-memo-NB-20260729.pdf, RI-updated-invoice-NB-202607.pdf
